children: U.S. President Donald Trump said his son, Donald Trump Jr., told him he would repay a Russian oligarch who funded his May wedding celebration in the Bahamas. According to Sina Finance, Democratic lawmakers in Congress launched an investigation this week after reports said Russian businessman and International Boxing Association President Umar Kremlev paid hundreds of thousands of dollars for the event. Trump told reporters on Friday that when he asked his son about the reports, Donald Trump Jr. replied, "Dad, I will pay the money back." A person familiar with the matter confirmed that Donald Trump Jr. plans to reimburse Kremlev.

title: Trump Says Son Will Repay Wedding Party Costs Funded by Russian Oligarch
